text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... what should I do? It might be a bit 
too far away...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was looking for an ice skating rink 
within reach of the Academy, but as 
expected, there isn't one nearby.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was home, I used to go skiing 
all the time for a change of pace... It 
felt refreshing in a totally different way 
from running...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—No, homesickness is forbidden! Trainer, 
please help me find an easier way to 
change my mood!!
